# ContainerImage

`c.ContainerImage` calls the API's ContainerImage group. The Docker images of
the host.

### List

```go
func (s *ContainerImageService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[ContainerImageEntry]], error)
```

List the images of the host.

Reads each image through gohai's docker collector, which runs docker images. A
host whose docker does not answer reports skipped.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/container/image`, and needs the permission
`image:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host with an image, `go run container_image.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.ContainerImage.List(ctx, target)
```

### Pull

```go
func (s *ContainerImageService) Pull(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input ContainerImagePullInput,
) (*Response[Collection[ContainerImagePullResult]], error)
```

Pull an image.

Runs docker pull, and answers the ID and the size of the image that the host has
after it. A pull that gets nothing new, because the host had the image of that
reference already, reports changed: false.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/container/image/pull`, and needs the
permission `image:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Pull an image, `go run container_image.go pull`:

```go
resp, err := c.ContainerImage.Pull(ctx, target, client.ContainerImagePullInput{Image: "alpine:3.20"})
```

### Delete

```go
func (s *ContainerImageService) Delete(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input ContainerImageDeleteInput,
) (*Response[Collection[ContainerImageResult]], error)
```

Remove an image.

Runs docker rmi, with -f when force is set, which removes an image that a
container uses. An image that the host does not have reports changed: false.

It sends `DELETE /api/node/{hostname}/container/image/{image}`, and needs the
permission `image:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Remove an image, `go run container_image.go delete`:

```go
resp, err := c.ContainerImage.Delete(ctx, target, client.ContainerImageDeleteInput{Image: "alpine:3.20"})
```
